text:
anya: quick sync: noticed p95/p99 increase after yesterday's kernel-selector tweak on dedicated pools. decode stage appears to be the culprit — initial-chunk vs streaming decode breakdown below.

mike: can you paste the profiler excerpt? is KV cache miss rate up or routing churn?

anya: small profiler excerpt from a sample job: 
```
GPU kernels: 
  aten::matmul              45%
  decode_kern_v2            30%  # fused decode kernel we enabled
  streaming_decode          10%
CPU/KV: 
  KV cache miss rate: 8% -> 22% during tail spikes
  CPU user: 12% system: 3%
```

sophia: 22% KV miss is huge. did we change routing or TTLs?

anya: we did change kernel-selector heuristic: prefer fused decode when seq_len >= 64 to reduce ops. seems fine for avg latency, but with bigger microbatches under bursts, fused kernel overhead on small sequences spikes decode time.

javier: `/svc/profiler run --range=24h --tag=dedicated-optim` shows spikes line up with microbatch sizes > 12 and model variant v2q. also a few CPU GC pauses in the window.

kevin: proposal: cap microbatch for latency-sensitive routes (`--max-microbatch=8`) and prefer non-fused decode for seq < 80. we can add adaptive logic to avoid a one-size-fits-all flip.

anya: action proposal: revert kernel-selector default on dedicated to pre-tweak behavior, add adaptive rule: if seq_len < 80 && tail_kv_miss_rate > 10% -> force non-fused decode. also soft cap microbatch=10 on latency SLO routes.

mike: @perf-bot can you schedule a canary with that config?

perf-bot: perf-bot: scheduled canary on `dedicated-us-west-2` with config `microbatch_cap=10,kernel_policy=adaptive` starting in 15m. will post results.

sophia: :thumbsup: also let's split p95/p99 dashboards by stage (initial-chunk vs streaming decode). current dashboards show combined token latency which hides stage regressions.

javier: added a query draft: `sum(rate(token_latency_seconds{stage!="total"}[5m])) by (stage)` — will turn into a panel and alert if `p99_decode > 0.2` for 5m.

anya: quick local test: `curl -XPOST /infer -d '{"seq_len":32,"microbatch":16}'` -> p99 decode 320ms vs 120ms when microbatch=8. logs show `decode_kern_v2 launched x16` and stall in kernel queue.

kevin: check kv cache sharding too — misses could come from shard churn if routing changed. if sessions aren't sticky, collocated hot keys will suffer.

anya: will run a simulation to produce a colocation heatmap and share numbers.

mike: if sim shows shard churn, fallback is sticky routing for 60s per session id for latency routes.

perf-bot: canary finished: p95 reduced 180ms -> 140ms, p99 reduced 420ms -> 260ms on latency routes; KV miss rate dropped 21% -> 9% during canary window.

anya: solid. plan: gradual rollout starting with latency-SLO routes only, monitor p99 and KV miss rate, then expand if stable.

sophia: also add a note to release notes: kernel-selector heuristic tweak + microbatch cap for latency routes (include perf numbers).

javier: I'll open a PR with config changes + dashboard panels and the alert rule.

anya: thanks all — i'll follow up with heatmap and the PR link when ready.
